# Temporary Hit Points

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Stats](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#TemporaryHitPoints)*

Temporary Hit Points are granted by certain effects and act as a buffer against losing real [Hit Points](Hit-Points.md). *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Damage and Healing](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#TemporaryHitPoints)").
